nodes.rationale: Cankers are a long-term overwintering reservoir and ecological niche for Ea; characterizing their microbiome may identify biocontrol agents / synthetic communities for fire blight management.

nodes.label: Microbiome-to-pathobiome shift (dysbiosis)
nodes.rationale: Increased richness in cankers reflects secondary opportunistic colonization of necrotic tissue and loss of keystone-driven stability.

nodes.label: Alpha diversity (Shannon, Simpson, Chao1, observed)
nodes.rationale: Canker richness higher than healthy; interpreted as saprophytic enrichment/ecosystem dysfunction rather than health.

nodes.label: Beta diversity: Bray-Curtis PCoA + PERMANOVA
nodes.rationale: Health status explained 17.2% variance (P=0.001); cultivar alone NS; interaction significant.

nodes.label: FAPROTAX functional prediction (microeco)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over PICRUSt2 because its curated ecological guilds fit full-length 16S and the goal of ecology-focused testable hypotheses; PICRUSt2 optimized for short hypervariable-region reads.

nodes.label: SparCC co-occurrence networks via MENAP (Cytoscape/Gephi)
nodes.rationale: Healthy networks denser (0.54 vs 0.12-0.19); canker networks fragmented with Ea ASV1032 as hub.

nodes.rationale: Return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify update (AST-only rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Keeps graph current after code edits at no API cost.

nodes.label: Graphify Project Rules
nodes.rationale: Use graph query/path/explain before grepping or reading raw files to keep context scoped; run graphify update after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.
